title: Data Exchange Standards for PBM Services Agreement Sponsors
content:
Eligibility Operations at Northbridge Rx exchanges two kinds of data with plan sponsors under the PBM Services Agreement: eligibility files that the sponsor sends in, and claims data that Northbridge Rx sends out to the sponsor's vendors. The standards below differ by pricing arrangement.

## Inbound: sponsor eligibility files

- **File frequency** — how often the sponsor sends eligibility files.
- **Error threshold** — the share of a file's records rejected above which the whole file is held for the sponsor to correct.
- **Load time** — the number of business days in which a clean eligibility file is loaded.

| Pricing arrangement | File frequency | Error threshold (share of records rejected) | Load time for a clean file (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | weekly | 5% | 2 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | weekly | 5% | 2 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | weekly | 5% | 2 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | daily | 3% | 1 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | daily | 3% | 1 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | daily | 3% | 1 |

## Outbound: claims data feed to the sponsor's vendors

| Pricing arrangement | Claims data feed frequency |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | monthly |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | monthly |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | weekly |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | weekly |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | daily |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | daily |

## Questions on the standards

**Is the load time counted in calendar days?** No. The load time for a clean eligibility file is stated in business days: 2 for the first three arrangements listed, 1 for the last three.

**Which arrangements send eligibility daily?** Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus, Northbridge Enterprise Value and Northbridge Coalition Purchasing; the same three carry the 3% error threshold.

**Do the eligibility file frequency and the claims data feed frequency always match?** No. Under Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus, for example, eligibility files come weekly and the claims data feed also runs weekly, while under Northbridge Traditional Pricing eligibility files come weekly and the claims data feed runs monthly.
